note: Enhanced PR Freelance scrape — 7-day window (2026-05-18 → 2026-05-25). Sources: agency career pages verified live this run (Peregrine Communications, Lowe Group, Sondhelm Partners, Avaans Media), plus Google/Bing-indexed LinkedIn/Indeed/ZipRecruiter/Glassdoor results, O'Dwyer's directory, Crunchbase. Search clusters covered: freelance PR / PR consultant; communications & media-relations consultant (contract/freelance); fractional/interim communications; outsourced/agency-overflow/white-label PR; earned-media consultant / publicist contractor. Deduplicated against pr-freelance-scrape and daily-scrape reports 2026-04-30 → 2026-05-22. Skipped repeats already captured in prior runs, including: Water & Wall Group, StreetCred PR, Forefront Communications, Hello Human, Gasthalter & Co, Prosek Partners, KCSA Strategic Communications, JConnelly, FiComm Partners, The James Collective, Peppercomm, Mission North, Bospar, BerlinRosen, Highwire PR, Antenna Group, Dukas Linden, Method Communications, M Booth, H/Advisors, Cardinal Communications, Haven Tower Group, Conway Communications, FINN Partners, Crackle PR, Edelman Smithfield, Gregory FCA/BackBay, Infinite Global, The Work Crowd, William Mills Agency, Caliber Corporate Advisers, 5WPR, Cognito Media, Vested, Inkhouse, Reputation Management Consultants. This run surfaces three NEW financial-sector comms firms with live, verified hiring/capacity signals (Peregrine Communications — strongest fit of the week; Lowe Group; Sondhelm Partners) plus one explicit remote/part-time engagement-model posting flagged OFF-ICP on sector (Avaans Media, consumer PR). Note on intent: every financial lead this week advertises FT or non-PR reqs, so the freelance/overflow angle is a senior cold pitch rather than an advertised contract — this is consistent with the broader trend that boutique financial PR shops rarely post freelance reqs publicly and prefer warm, senior-to-senior introductions. Quality over quantity — 4 vetted leads, all with a live careers/job URL for Mark to review.
